🌆 Market News Digest
[Nov 4, 2026 EST]

🔥 Top Stories
• US equities rip higher after GOP midterm losses — S&P 500 +1.6%, Nasdaq +2.1%, Dow +3.0% as investors price policy shifts and a softer tariff/war backdrop
• Oil sinks on election shock + inventory draws — Brent and WTI plunge >8% and settle near $94.62/$88.12 after Democrats win Congress and US crude/diesel stocks keep falling
• Bitcoin spikes above $80K — short liquidations and improving election/regulatory sentiment lift BTC back above pre-hack levels

⛽ Oil & Energy
• EIA shows another weekly US inventory draw — crude -0.9M bbl, distillates -3.6M bbl; diesel stocks hit lowest since 2003
• UAE weighs third pipeline around Hormuz — further evidence Gulf producers are planning for geopolitical risk
• BP ramps Kirkuk drilling; European gas falls — energy supply headlines stayed active while TTF gas dropped as much as 5.3%

📊 Markets & Macro
• US services growth slows but stays expansionary — ISM services 54.5, S&P Global composite 55.9; ADP adds 86K jobs vs 67K est.
• Treasury funding hits the tape — quarterly refunding set at $125B, auction sizes in line; buyback accepted $6B of $39.6B offered
• Rates ease globally — France 10Y and UK gilt yields fall; Poland holds rates at 3.75%; ECB hawks warn inflation risks may re-accelerate

🌍 Geopolitical
• US-Iran tensions intensify — Trump says Iran war was “worth it” and not ruled out, while US extends Iran/China emergencies and Treasury adds new Iran-linked sanctions
• Israel on alert; Mideast de-escalation in focus — reports of possible Iranian strike keep regional risk elevated
• North Korea tests new air-defense missile — adds another Asian security flashpoint

🪙 Crypto & DeFi
• BTC rips on election relief — crypto fear gauge still “fear,” but price jumps to $80K-$81K on short liquidations
• Coinbase doubles down on custody — says >99% of customer funds stay in cold storage after Binance hack fears
• Stripe expands stablecoin payouts; US judge allows stock-perps — more rails opening for crypto payments and derivatives
• Democrats eye crypto probes — Bloomberg says new congressional majority plans investigations into Trump-family crypto ties

🏛️ Regulatory & Policy
• Trump comments on tariffs, war, and cabinet — says tariffs won’t be cut, can work with Democrats, and denies deciding on replacing Hegseth
• Democrats target healthcare and tariffs — Jeffries says ACA credits/Medicaid cuts will be priorities; Schumer vows to end the Iran war
• Data-center crackdown risk grows — Goldman warns state/local moratoria could hit 45% of planned US capacity after Democratic wins

🏢 Corporate
• Uber beats and guides up — Q3 EPS, bookings, and revenue topped estimates; Q4 bookings guidance also strong
• McDonald’s and Kraft Heinz beat — MCD margins/comp sales solid; KHC lifts FY EPS outlook and plans coffee divestment
• Big tech/AI capex wobbles — Microsoft lowers some data-center spending, Meta taps euro bonds and buys Conductor, Apple trims internal AI usage budgets
• Chips & semis mixed, but earnings hold up — Qualcomm, ARM, GlobalFoundries, Coherent beat; AMD price target cut by BofA
• M&A and defense/quantum activity — AstraZeneca makes $10B Rhythm bid; Rheinmetall strong sales; IonQ and D-Wave land quantum wins
